description.value: Halal Urban Fresh Meats is a specialty halal butcher shop and deli mart on Victoria's Quadra Street, offering certified Zabiha Halal cuts of beef, lamb, chicken, and goat prepared by master butchers with vacuum-packed, ready-to-cook convenience. Beyond fresh meat, the shop carries a global selection of sauces, marinades, and spices alongside grocery staples like canned goods, frozen items, breads, and rice. All products come with a 100% satisfaction guarantee, making it a reliable stop for cyclists seeking halal provisions in the city.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (covered) at 67m; rack (covered) at 72m; rack (covered) at 94m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at halalmeat2u.com fully corroborates the OSM address (2618 Quadra Street, Victoria BC V8T 4E4) and phone (250-361-1200), and the business appears active with detailed product pages and a contact form. The site confirms grocery staples (canned goods, breads, rice, frozen meats) alongside fresh halal meats, supporting the Groceries category. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any other cyclist-specific amenity appears anywhere in the OSM tags or website content. One notable concern: the front page text contains repeated references to 'Alia Halal Meat & Groceries' in what appear to be image labels, suggesting a possible name discrepancy or that some site assets were copied from a differently named business.
concerns: Website front page contains repeated references to 'Alia Halal Meat & Groceries' in what appear to be image labels or alt text, suggesting either a name discrepancy, assets borrowed from a different business, or a possible rebranding history. OSM name 'Halal Urban Fresh Meats' is used consistently in all text headings and the footer.
Website displays a typographical error in hours across multiple pages ('11:00 AM to :800 PM' instead of '8:00 PM'), indicating the site may not be actively maintained.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating specialty halal butcher and grocery shop with an active website, confirmed address, and phone. Useful to touring cyclists seeking halal food provisions in Victoria.
